arStrings.szText: "Have you discovered a way to banish Belial?"
There’s a ritual that can be performed. But we’ll need an artifact known as the Flayed Mask.
Its last known location was a Cathedral outpost overrun by cultists.
When the Cathedral learned of the cultists, they buried the outpost, and everything within.
But if you can find the outpost, and bring me the mask, then perhaps we can still banish Belial.
